plan: A spider jungler who shifts forms and locks you down with her cocoon before devouring you.
aSurveiller: Her E (Cocoon). It stuns you then she pounces on you in spider form: stay behind your minions.
contrer: Stay behind your minions: her cocoon (E) stops on the first one hit.
After a missed cocoon, it's time to engage her.
Watch out for her spider E: she rises into the air and drops on you.
forces: Dodges turret shots with her spider E.

sorts.P: Her spells create spiderlings that follow her.
sorts.Q: Venom that damages based on the target's health.
sorts.W: Explosive spiderling or attack speed frenzy.
sorts.E: Cocoon that stuns; as a spider she rises then drops.

momentFort: Ganks very hard from level 3 with her cocoon. She must get ahead early: she loses effectiveness in the late game.
